public_rationale: The search did not establish a comparable industry total. The claim also leaves the revenue period and run-rate treatment unstated. Neither $61 billion nor a materially different total is established by the retrieved evidence.
limitations: The provisional trailing-year interpretation is not supplied by Zitron.
The available research is incomplete for this industry-wide aggregation.
Failure to verify the estimate is not evidence that it is false.

statement.document_title: NVIDIA Isn't Enron - So What Is It?

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is an approximate annual industry revenue total around publication, covering model providers, applications and generative-AI cloud services.
For a provisional realized-revenue test, use the trailing year ending September 30, 2025, the latest completed reporting quarter before publication. The speaker did not specify this period.
Read total as provider revenue summed across the stated businesses. Whether to eliminate transactions between those businesses is unspecified.
Do not substitute annualized run rates, spending forecasts or general cloud revenue for realized generative-AI revenue.
criteria.support_condition: A transparent, broadly complete estimate for the same period and industry scope places revenue near $61 billion, with uncertainty sufficiently narrow to substantiate that approximate total.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evidence establishes a materially different total, or a non-overlapping subset alone establishes revenue materially above $61 billion.
